svg.title: Where the tokens go. — ICD-10-CM April 2026
svg.desc: Every primary category: total token cost, fact density and savings against equivalent canonical JSONL. All 41 primary categories. Bars share a linear, zero-based scale. Tokens/fact and saving percentages use each category’s own denominators.

text.tspan: Every primary category: total token cost, fact density and savings against equivalent canonical JSONL.

svg.text: cl100k_base • Measured serialization cost • LLM answer quality is not evaluated
Top five categories use 74.91% of delivered tokens.
Totals use weighted counts. Small files carry proportionally more framing; dense prose retains its full wording and ordered context.
